get_account_info.description: Get an account's state: the program that owns it, its balance, whether it is executable, and its data. Accounts the node can decode (token accounts, mints, stake and vote accounts) come back as readable fields; anything else keeps its data as base64.
get_account_info.display_str_template: Get the Solana account info for {0}.
get_account_info.name: get_account_info

parameters.description: Base58 address of the account to read. Any account works: a wallet, a token account, a mint, or a program.
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: Which Solana cluster to read from. Mainnet Beta is the live chain carrying real value; Devnet and Testnet are for trying a workflow out first and their tokens are worth nothing. Defaults to Mainnet Beta.
parameters.name: cluster

parameters.description: How settled the data has to be before the node answers. 'Finalized' is a block that can no longer be rolled back and is the right choice for anything about money; 'confirmed' is a couple of seconds fresher; 'processed' is the newest and the least certain. Defaults to finalized.
parameters.name: commitment

context_slot.description: Slot the node answered at, i.e. how current this reading is

data_base64.description: Raw account data, when it could not be decoded

executable.description: Whether the account is a program itself

exists.description: False when nothing has ever been created at this address; the rest of the fields are then empty

lamports.description: Balance in lamports, the chain's own unit (1 SOL = 1,000,000,000)

owner.description: Address of the program that owns the account

owner_program.description: Name of that program when it is a well-known one, e.g. 'SPL Token Program'

parsed.description: Decoded account fields, when the node could

program.description: Program the data was decoded as, e.g. 'spl-token'

rent_epoch.description: Epoch rent is next owed, when one applies

rent_exempt.description: Whether the account holds enough to owe no rent

sol.description: The same balance expressed in SOL

sol_string.description: The same balance in SOL as an exact decimal string, for balances too large to hold in a number without rounding

space.description: Size of the account's data, in bytes

get_balance.description: Get the SOL balance of any wallet or account address, in lamports and in SOL. An address that has never been funded reads as zero rather than as an error.
get_balance.name: get_balance

parameters.description: Base58 address of the wallet or account to read, for example '9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM'.
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: Which Solana cluster to read from. Mainnet Beta is the live chain carrying real value; Devnet and Testnet are for trying a workflow out first and their tokens are worth nothing. Defaults to Mainnet Beta.
parameters.name: cluster

parameters.description: How settled the data has to be before the node answers. 'Finalized' is a block that can no longer be rolled back and is the right choice for anything about money; 'confirmed' is a couple of seconds fresher; 'processed' is the newest and the least certain. Defaults to finalized.
parameters.name: commitment

context_slot.description: Slot the node answered at, i.e. how current this reading is

lamports.description: Balance in lamports, the chain's own unit (1 SOL = 1,000,000,000)

sol.description: The same balance expressed in SOL

sol_string.description: The same balance in SOL as an exact decimal string, for balances too large to hold in a number without rounding

get_network_status.description: Check that a Solana cluster is healthy and see where it is in the current epoch: the slot it has reached, how far through the epoch that is, and the version the node runs. Useful as a guard before a workflow reads anything else.
get_network_status.name: get_network_status

parameters.description: Which Solana cluster to read from. Mainnet Beta is the live chain carrying real value; Devnet and Testnet are for trying a workflow out first and their tokens are worth nothing. Defaults to Mainnet Beta.
parameters.name: cluster

endpoint.description: RPC endpoint the check was made against

epoch_progress_percent.description: How far through the epoch the cluster is

health.description: 'ok', or what the node said about being behind

healthy.description: Whether the node is caught up with the cluster

slot.description: Highest slot the node has reached

transaction_count.description: Transactions the cluster has ever processed

get_signatures_for_address.description: List the transactions that touched an address, newest first, with each one's signature, time, and whether it succeeded. This is how a workflow watches a wallet: hand a signature to 'Get transaction' for the detail, or stop at the last one already seen so a scheduled run only picks up what is new.
get_signatures_for_address.display_str_template: Get the recent Solana transactions for {0}.
get_signatures_for_address.name: get_signatures_for_address

parameters.description: Base58 address to list transactions for. A wallet, a token account, or a program all work.
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: How many transactions to return, newest first, from 1 to 1000. Defaults to 10.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Return only transactions older than this signature. Pass the 'oldest_signature' of a previous run to page further back in time.
parameters.name: before

parameters.description: Stop at this signature and return only what is newer than it. Pass the 'newest_signature' a previous run saw so a scheduled workflow picks up only new activity.
parameters.name: until

parameters.description: Which Solana cluster to read from. Mainnet Beta is the live chain carrying real value; Devnet and Testnet are for trying a workflow out first and their tokens are worth nothing. Defaults to Mainnet Beta.
parameters.name: cluster

parameters.description: How settled the data has to be before the node answers. 'Finalized' is a block that can no longer be rolled back and is the right choice for anything about money; 'confirmed' is a couple of seconds fresher. Defaults to finalized.
parameters.name: commitment

address.description: Address the transactions were listed for

newest_signature.description: First signature in the list, to use as 'until' next run

oldest_signature.description: Last signature in the list, for paging back

block_time.description: Block time as seconds since the Unix epoch

block_time_iso.description: The same block time as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp

error.description: Why it failed, or null when it succeeded

memo.description: Memo attached to it, if any

signature.description: Transaction signature; pass to 'Get transaction' for detail

succeeded.description: Whether the transaction ran without error

get_token_accounts_by_owner.description: List the SPL token balances held by a wallet, one row per token account with its mint and amount. Narrow it to a single mint to ask about one token, such as how much USDC a wallet holds.
get_token_accounts_by_owner.display_str_template: Get the Solana token balances of {0}.
get_token_accounts_by_owner.name: get_token_accounts_by_owner

parameters.description: Base58 address of the wallet whose token balances to read. This is the wallet itself, not one of its token accounts.
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Mint address of a single token to report on, for example the USDC mint. Leave blank to return every token account the wallet holds.
parameters.name: mint

parameters.description: Which token program to look under when no mint is given. Most tokens use the original SPL Token program; newer ones with transfer fees or interest use Token-2022, and its accounts are invisible to a query for the original.
parameters.name: token_program

parameters.description: Include token accounts holding a zero balance. A wallet keeps an account for every token it has ever touched, so these are left out by default.
parameters.name: include_empty

parameters.description: Which Solana cluster to read from. Mainnet Beta is the live chain carrying real value; Devnet and Testnet are for trying a workflow out first and their tokens are worth nothing. Defaults to Mainnet Beta.
parameters.name: cluster

parameters.description: How settled the data has to be before the node answers. 'Finalized' is a block that can no longer be rolled back and is the right choice for anything about money; 'confirmed' is a couple of seconds fresher; 'processed' is the newest and the least certain. Defaults to finalized.
parameters.name: commitment

account_lamports.description: Lamports held by the token account for its own rent

amount.description: Raw amount in the token's smallest unit, as a string because it can be larger than a number holds exactly

decimals.description: Decimal places the mint uses, e.g. 6 for USDC

is_native.description: Whether the account holds wrapped SOL rather than a token

mint.description: Mint address of the token the account holds

pubkey.description: Address of the token account itself

ui_amount.description: The human-readable amount, with those decimals already applied

ui_amount_string.description: The same human figure as an exact decimal string

context_slot.description: Slot the node answered at, i.e. how current this reading is

mint.description: Mint the query was narrowed to, or null

token_program.description: Token program the query covered, or null when a mint was given instead

total_accounts.description: Accounts before empty ones were filtered out

get_token_supply.description: Get the circulating supply of an SPL token from its mint address, as the raw amount and with the mint's decimals applied.
get_token_supply.display_str_template: Get the Solana token supply for {0}.
get_token_supply.name: get_token_supply

parameters.description: Base58 mint address of the token, for example 'EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v' for USDC.
parameters.name: mint

parameters.description: Which Solana cluster to read from. Mainnet Beta is the live chain carrying real value; Devnet and Testnet are for trying a workflow out first and their tokens are worth nothing. Defaults to Mainnet Beta.
parameters.name: cluster

parameters.description: How settled the data has to be before the node answers. 'Finalized' is a block that can no longer be rolled back and is the right choice for anything about money; 'confirmed' is a couple of seconds fresher; 'processed' is the newest and the least certain. Defaults to finalized.
parameters.name: commitment

amount.description: Raw amount in the token's smallest unit, as a string because it can be larger than a number holds exactly

context_slot.description: Slot the node answered at, i.e. how current this reading is

decimals.description: Decimal places the mint uses, e.g. 6 for USDC

ui_amount.description: The human-readable amount, with those decimals already applied

ui_amount_string.description: The same human figure as an exact decimal string

get_transaction.description: Get a confirmed transaction by signature, with what it actually moved worked out: the fee, the instructions it ran, and the SOL and token balance changes per account. Use it to confirm a payment arrived and for how much.
get_transaction.name: get_transaction

parameters.description: Base58 transaction signature, the long string an explorer shows for a transaction, or one returned by 'Get recent transactions'.
parameters.name: signature

parameters.description: Include the program log messages the transaction emitted. They are long and mostly useful for working out why something failed, so they are left out by default.
parameters.name: include_logs

parameters.description: Which Solana cluster to read from. Mainnet Beta is the live chain carrying real value; Devnet and Testnet are for trying a workflow out first and their tokens are worth nothing. Defaults to Mainnet Beta.
parameters.name: cluster

parameters.description: How settled the data has to be before the node answers. 'Finalized' is a block that can no longer be rolled back and is the right choice for anything about money; 'confirmed' is a couple of seconds fresher. Defaults to finalized.
parameters.name: commitment

accounts.description: Every account the transaction referenced, in order

block_time.description: Block time as seconds since the Unix epoch

block_time_iso.description: The same block time as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp

error.description: Why it failed, or null when it succeeded

fee_payer.description: Account that paid the fee (the first signer)

fee_sol.description: The same fee expressed in SOL

fee_sol_string.description: The same fee in SOL as an exact decimal string

items.description: One instruction: the program that ran it, its type, and its decoded fields when available

logs.description: Program log messages, when they were asked for

recent_blockhash.description: Blockhash the transaction was signed against

items.description: An account whose SOL balance changed, with the before, after, and difference

succeeded.description: Whether the transaction ran without error

items.description: A token account whose balance changed, with its mint, owner, and the difference

description: Read the Solana blockchain through its keyless public JSON-RPC endpoints: SOL and SPL token balances, account state, a wallet's recent transactions, a transaction's full detail with the balance changes it caused, token supply, and cluster health. No account or API key required.
